courses.name: Fundamentals
courses.line: Every punch from zero, taught by Stafford.

lessons.name: Stance and movement
lessons.about: Teaches how to stand and move before any punch: the stance, orthodox or southpaw, with the hands up, then stepping every way and circling in it, each from Stafford and then on AMBO's calls, and a freestyle round to finish.
lessons.camera: Put your phone about waist high, facing you, 2 to 3 metres away, with your whole body in the picture.

drills.title: Learn the stance
drills.line: Watch the coach teach the stance, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.

Copy each part with him: feet shoulder width, then the back foot steps back (the right foot if you're right-handed, orthodox; the left if you're left-handed, southpaw), knees bent, fists made with the thumb outside, the back fist on your chin, elbows in, the front fist in line with your chin.
mistakes: Standing up straight: with straight legs you're slow to move and have no power to punch.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice your stance
drills.line: Jump, and land in your stance with your knees bent.
how: Facing the phone, AMBO says "jump" 10 times: a small jump on the spot each time, landing in your stance.
Land with your knees bent, feet shoulder width and the back foot back, hands up; AMBO reads your feet once they settle.
mistakes: Landing with your feet close together, or side by side: you're off balance.
drills.moveOn: At least 8 of the 10 landings with no cue.

detect.what: Each jump is one rep: the feet read once they settle, too close across or front to back (Feet stance's check).

drills.title: Learn the steps
drills.line: Watch the coach teach moving in your stance, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.
Copy each part with him: whichever way you go, that foot steps first and the other follows the same distance, pushing off the other foot; stay side-on and never cross your feet.
mistakes: A small step with one foot and a big one with the other, so your feet end up close together.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice steps each way
drills.line: Forward, back, left, right, one step each, at your own pace.
how: AMBO calls forward, back, left and right in that order, one step each, and calls the next one a second after your step has landed.
The foot on the side you're going steps first and the other follows the same distance; push off the other foot so it never drags.
mistakes: Dragging the back foot along the floor instead of pushing off it.
drills.moveOn: At least 80% of the 16 steps started by the right foot; unclear steps don't count.

detect.what: Each step call is one rep: which foot left the floor first (Step and slide's step judge).

drills.title: Practice called steps
drills.line: The steps come at random, and quicker as you go.
how: AMBO calls a step forward, back, left or right at random, never more than a step from where you started, the gaps getting shorter.
Go straight away: the foot on the side you're going first, equal steps, feet never crossing.
mistakes: Stepping off whichever foot is lighter when the call surprises you.
drills.moveOn: At least 80% of the 20 steps started by the right foot; unclear steps don't count.

detect.what: Each step call is one rep: which foot left the floor first (Step and slide's step judge).

drills.title: Learn circling
drills.line: Watch the coach teach circling, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.

Put something on the floor a step in front of you, like a bottle, and circle it with him: a small step with the front foot, a bigger one with the back, the foot on the side you're going first, facing it the whole time.
mistakes: Equal steps with both feet: you turn away from what you're circling.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice switching direction
drills.line: When I say switch, change direction at once.
how: You circle the marker; at random, sometimes after a long while and sometimes straight away, AMBO calls "switch".
Change direction at once, the foot on the new side stepping first: small steps with the front foot, bigger ones with the back.
mistakes: Crossing the feet or bringing them together as you change direction.

detect.what: Calls (Switch) on the clock. Nothing judged on camera yet.

drills.title: Practice called moves
drills.line: I call any move: two steps forward, back, left or right, or circle.
how: AMBO calls two steps forward, back, left or right, or "circle left" or "circle right" (keep circling until the next call), and keeps you near the middle.
That foot first on every step, feet never crossing on the circles.
mistakes: Crossing the feet when a step call comes in the middle of a circle.
drills.moveOn: At least 80% of the 12 step calls with every step started by the right foot; circles and unclear calls don't count.

detect.what: Each step call is one rep: which foot left the floor first (Step and slide's step judge). Circle calls aren't judged.

drills.title: Practice freestyle
drills.line: Move in your stance your way: forward, back, side to side and circling.
how: One 2-minute round with no calls.
Move every way in your stance: that foot first, equal steps, hands up, circling both ways.
mistakes: Only moving one way.

detect.what: Free round, no calls. Each straight step found and judged on its first foot (the free step finder); circling isn't scored.

lessons.name: Jab and cross
lessons.about: Teaches the jab and the cross from zero: each punch from Stafford, then called by AMBO, then the double jab and the 1-2, and a freestyle round to finish.
lessons.camera: Put your phone about waist high, facing you, 2 to 3 metres away, with your whole body in the picture.

drills.title: Learn the jab
drills.line: Watch the coach teach the jab, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.
Copy each part with him: elbow in, the arm all the way out, the knuckles turning over at the end, and the small step with it.
mistakes: Letting the elbow flare out to the side as the jab goes out.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice the jab
drills.line: I call one, you jab.
how: AMBO says "one" 20 times, a couple of seconds apart, never on a steady beat.
Jab on each call and bring it straight back to your guard.
mistakes: Jabbing on the beat you expect instead of on the call.

detect.what: Each call is one rep: every punch judged on its hand and kind by the punch model (detection identical to the backend's). Generous: the called kind counts at 5% of the punch or 20% in one frame; a wind-up running into the punch is part of it.

drills.title: Learn the double jab
drills.line: Watch the coach teach the double jab, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.
Copy him: push off the back foot, the first jab only half way out, hands and feet moving together.
mistakes: Two full jabs from a standing start, with no push off the back foot.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice 1 or 1-1
drills.line: I call one for a single jab, or one, one for a double.
how: AMBO calls "one" or "one, one" 20 times, more singles than doubles, the singles coming quicker.
Throw what is called and come back to your guard after each.
mistakes: Throwing a double when a single was called.

detect.what: Each call is one rep: every punch judged on its hand and kind by the punch model (detection identical to the backend's). Generous: the called kind counts at 5% of the punch or 20% in one frame; a wind-up running into the punch is part of it.

drills.title: Learn the cross
drills.line: Watch the coach teach the cross, and copy each part as it comes.
how: The coach's video plays and teaches it one part at a time.
Copy him: turn the shoulders and the hips, the knuckles turning over at the end, and use your range.
mistakes: Turning too far, or the rear heel coming off the floor.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice the cross
drills.line: I call two, you throw the cross.
how: AMBO says "two" 20 times, a couple of seconds apart, never on a steady beat.
Throw the cross on each call, turning through the shoulders and hips, and come back to your guard.

detect.what: Each call is one rep: every punch judged on its hand and kind by the punch model (detection identical to the backend's). Generous: the called kind counts at 5% of the punch or 20% in one frame; a wind-up running into the punch is part of it.

drills.title: Learn the shoulder twist

Twist your shoulders with him on each go and reset, 5 times, then throw 5 crosses with him, turning the same way.

drills.line: I call one, two.
how: AMBO says "one, two" 20 times, with a few seconds between.
Throw the jab, then the cross, and come back to your guard after the 2.
mistakes: Pulling the jab back late, so the cross has to wait for it.

detect.what: Each call is one rep: every punch judged on its hand and kind by the punch model (detection identical to the backend's). Generous: the called kind counts at 5% of the punch or 20% in one frame; a wind-up running into the punch is part of it.

drills.title: Practice 1 or 1-2
drills.line: I call one for a jab, or one, two for a 1-2.
how: AMBO calls "one" or "one, two" 20 times, more jabs than 1-2s.
Throw what is called and come back to your guard after each.

detect.what: Each call is one rep: every punch judged on its hand and kind by the punch model (detection identical to the backend's). Generous: the called kind counts at 5% of the punch or 20% in one frame; a wind-up running into the punch is part of it.

drills.title: Practice freestyle
drills.line: Throw jabs and crosses your way, in any mix.
how: One 2-minute round with no calls.
Jabs, double jabs, crosses and 1-2s in any order, moving as you like.
mistakes: Throwing only 1-2s; use the double jab and the single jab too.

detect.what: Free round, no calls. Recorded and uploaded; nothing judged in the app.

Your punches, ducks, rolls and double rolls, moving as you like.
mistakes: Rolling with the hands down as you tire.

lessons.name: Defense combinations
lessons.about: Puts offense, defense and counters together: four of the coach's combinations called one at a time, then any of them, then your own.
lessons.camera: Put your phone about waist high, facing you, 2 to 3 metres away, with your whole body in the picture.

drills.title: Learn what this lesson covers
drills.line: The coach explains this lesson: offense, defense and counters together, on my call.
how: The coach's video explains the lesson; watch it, no need to copy along.
From here on each call mixes punches and defences: stay loose and keep moving between calls, then tense up and throw when you hear one.
mistakes: Staying tense between calls.

detect.what: Video to watch and copy. Nothing to detect.

drills.title: Practice 1-2, body block, 6-3
drills.line: I call one, two, body block, six, three.
how: AMBO says "one, two, body block, six, three" at changing gaps.
Throw and defend it all the way through, then back to your stance and stay loose until the next call.
mistakes: Dropping only the arm for the body block.

detect.what: Calls (1-2, body block, 6-3) on the clock. Nothing judged on camera yet.

drills.title: Practice 1-2-3, body block, 5-2
drills.line: I call one, two, three, body block, five, two.
how: AMBO says "one, two, three, body block, five, two" at changing gaps.
Throw and defend it all the way through, then back to your stance and stay loose until the next call.
mistakes: Leaning over the front knee after the lead hook.

detect.what: Calls (1-2-3, body block, 5-2) on the clock. Nothing judged on camera yet.

drills.title: Practice 1-2, slip, roll, 3-2, step back, 1
drills.line: I call one, two, slip, roll, three, two, step back, one.
how: AMBO says "one, two, slip, roll, three, two, step back, one" at changing gaps.
Throw and defend it all the way through, then back to your stance and stay loose until the next call.
mistakes: Rushing the slip and the roll into one movement.
drills.moveOn: At least 80% of the 10 calls defended as called; calls AMBO couldn't see don't count.

drills.title: Practice 1, slip, 5-2, roll, 1-1-2
drills.line: I call one, slip, five, two, roll, one, one, two.
how: AMBO says "one, slip, five, two, roll, one, one, two" at changing gaps.
Throw and defend it all the way through, then back to your stance and stay loose until the next call.
mistakes: Standing up straight between the defences.

drills.title: Practice any combination
drills.line: I call any of the four combinations.
how: AMBO calls all four combinations, as many of each, at changing gaps.
Throw and defend what's called, loose and moving between calls.
mistakes: Throwing the combination you expect instead of the one called.

drills.title: Practice freestyle
drills.line: Offense, defense and counters your way, and keep moving.
how: One 2-minute round with no calls.
Punch, defend and counter as you like, loose between your combinations.
mistakes: Only attacking: defend and counter too.
